requires: Rungs have no "save": they play mopic_demo1's own progress (global1.sav). Today's run-ladder.ps1 refuses that before the first launch ('rung <name> has no save'); it needs the save-less rung change (proposal in the session notes: skip -SaveFile and the save_slot check when a rung has no save). Without the change, pin every rung to the baseline instead: "save": "runs\\save-sets\\tekken8demo\\own\\20261002-baseline\\76561199750818073\\global1.sav" (all these recipes have a save_slot for global1.sav).
notes: TEKKEN 8 Demo build 13144577 (appid 2524440). No Steam Cloud: saves are local only, in %LOCALAPPDATA%\TEKKEN 8 Demo\Saved\SaveGames\<SteamID64>. Baseline copy of both accounts' saves (10 files): runs\save-sets\tekken8demo\own\20261002-baseline (set.json has the hashes).

Demo content: Story 'The Dark Awakens' Chapter 1, Arcade Quest Chapter 1, Super Ghost Battle (unlocked by clearing Arcade Quest Chapter 1; your own ghost), Player vs Player (needs 2 pads, not covered), Player vs CPU with JIN, KAZUYA, PAUL, NINA on Urban Square (Evening), Yakushima, Sanctum (+ Random), Gallery (partial). ONLINE, CUSTOMIZE, COMMUNITY are unavailable; no achievements or leaderboards.
Order matters without saves: aq-ch1 must clear Arcade Quest Chapter 1 before ghost can open Super Ghost Battle. With pinned saves, ghost would pin aq-ch1's run folder save-after\global1.sav instead.

Tiers: 1 = one rung per content item (story, Arcade Quest, each fighter and each stage once); 2 = Super Ghost Battle and the other 8 fighter x stage pairs; 3 = Gallery. story-ch1, aq-ch1, ghost and gallery are skeleton drafts: their unrecorded screens are listed under todo_checkpoints in the recipes; a run stops at the first one (MENU_FAIL) until a discovery run records them.

pvc-* rungs: P1 cursor starts on JIN in row 2 (PAUL, JIN, ?, KAZUYA, NINA), the CPU stays KAZUYA (in_match is the P2 KAZUYA plate), difficulty EASY, stage_moves from RANDOM: 1 Urban Square (Evening), 2 Yakushima, 3 Sanctum (order read from thumbnails; titles TODO). About 4 min per rung including boot and quit.
